notes.title: Notice of Update Distribution
notes.content:
The following updates have been made to the Steam version of Resident Evil Revelations [2/7/2024]

*	Miscellaneous bug fixes
*	Re-deployment of DLC that was previously released

notes.title: Capcom rolls back Resident Evil Revelations update that caused performance problems and crashes as fans accuse it of trying to sneak in DRM in order to kill mod support
notes.content:
Capcom is facing accusations from fans that it's quietly adding new DRM to its older games on PC, in what appears to be an attempt to crack down on the use of mods. But the process went from "quiet" to "very noisy" after a recent update to Resident Evil Revelations caused slowdown and crashes, and prevented some mods from working. Shortly after the update went live Capcom rolled it back, but said it will be re-released once the problem is resolved...
                Read more.

notes.title: Regarding the update
notes.content:
Due to an issue observed with the latest update released, we have reverted the corresponding update.
 
We apologize for the inconvenience caused, and once the issue is resolved, we will re-release the update.
Thank you very much for your patience and cooperation.

notes.title: Resident Evil Revelations Update Released
notes.content:
Update/Additions:
- 2560x1440 and 1440x900 screen resolution added.
- Aim Assist ON/OFF toggle added.
- Mouse Acceleration ON/OFF toggle added.

Bug fix:
- 120Hz Refresh Rate setting not saving under certain circumstance.

notes.title: Pirate Jill and Chris, Ninja Keith costumes unlockable
notes.content:
Picture is worth a thousand words - as with the other costumes, these are unlocked by playing through the campaign and Raid Mode, or other unlocking mechanisms. Exactly HOW you do this (and what their Raid Mode stats are) will remain a mystery :)
